verdicts.reason: A keeps the RSVP Free button as a clear focal point and keeps the orange can, but the reading order is jumbled. The date block sits far left, the headline is pushed to the far right, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the headline. The tagline, URL and date details are tiny, unreadable slivers, and the logo is almost gone. B gives the headline a strong spot on the left, but it drops the RSVP CTA and the product illustration completely. It also crams the body copy into an illegible three-line paragraph and strands a faint 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' at the bottom edge, below the date.
